GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

3. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

11. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

14. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

15. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
